summary:
WhatsApp Web is what people usually want from a WhatsApp favicon search. The fetch starts at web.whatsapp.com, then the marketing host. A phone’s installed app icon is not substituted if the web host does not return it.

Checked 12 November 2026 against whatsapp.com. HTML came from https://www.whatsapp.com/ (HTTP 400). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://web.whatsapp.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 32988 bytes. Directory sizes: 64×64, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://web.whatsapp.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 192×192 png.

Brand colour #22dd66 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-192x192-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-192x192-01.png at 192×192 (png, 5972 bytes) from https://web.whatsapp.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
